name: gpuix-fractalsvelte-ui
description: Themed Svelte 5 components that render natively in GPUI through gpuix-fractalsvelte.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: ThemeProvider, the --ui-* token contract and the built-in themes.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline status message with a tone, optional title and a dismiss control.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Circle or square user image, falling back to initials from a name.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small pill label for counts, statuses and tags, in five tones and three variants.

items.name: box
items.title: Box
items.description: Plain flex column with optional padding, background, border and corner radius.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Trail of ancestor pages, with the last item marked as the current page.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Clickable action with variants, tones, sizes, shapes, loading and icon slots.

items.name: buttongroup
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: Row of attached buttons, or a segmented single-select control driven by options and value.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Surface with a header, body and footer, optionally clickable as a whole.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Boolean or indeterminate check with a label, in three sizes, controlled by the parent.

items.name: contextmenu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: Wraps a region and opens a menu of actions on right click or ctrl+click.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, with an optional centred label.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Panel that slides in from the left, right or bottom over a scrim, with title, body and footer.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Equal-width column grid with a spacing gap between cells.

items.name: iconbutton
items.title: IconButton
items.description: Square icon-only action with a hover tooltip, sharing Button's variants, tones and sizes.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard shortcut caps for a chord such as cmd+k, drawn with macOS glyphs.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Inline text action with tones, underlined on hover.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown of actions anchored to a trigger, with shortcuts, tones, disabled items and separators.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Centred dialog over a scrim, with title, body and footer actions.

items.name: navlist
items.title: NavList
items.description: Vertical sidebar list with section headings, optional icons and badges.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page controls with previous and next buttons and a windowed run of page numbers around the current page.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, or to window coordinates, that closes on outside press or Escape.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Horizontal progress bar for a known percentage, or an indeterminate sweep.

items.name: radiogroup
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: Pick one of a few options, in a column or a row, with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: scrollarea
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: Vertically scrolling column with a fixed height or a height cap, and a drawn scroll thumb.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Dropdown that picks one option from a list, with keyboard navigation and a scrolling list for long option sets.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number in a range by dragging the thumb, clicking the track or using the arrow keys.

items.name: spacer
items.title: Spacer
items.description: Flexible empty box that takes up the free space in a row or column.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Indeterminate loading indicator drawn as a ring of fading dots.

items.name: splitpane
items.title: SplitPane
items.description: Two panes divided by a draggable, keyboard-nudgeable grip, side by side or stacked.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Flex row or column with spacing, alignment, justification and optional wrapping.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off toggle with a track and thumb, optional label, and three sizes.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between sibling views with an underline or a segmented pill control.

items.name: textarea
items.title: TextArea
items.description: Multi-line text field with label, hint or error text, and a height that grows with its content.

items.name: textinput
items.title: TextInput
items.description: Single-line text field with label, hint or error text, leading and trailing slots, and three sizes.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacked notifications shown bottom-right, raised with the toast() function and dismissed by timer or close button.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Button that holds a pressed or unpressed state, with a tone for the pressed look.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short hover hint beside a trigger, shown after a delay and hidden when the pointer leaves.
